def: §262 NK_v1 §2 slice audit (G-D): every consumer of the carried state S in boxes/inject_aw.py (incl. scratch/s240_build/head_s240.py's hold_step), boxes/nk.py and boxes/inject_aw_eval.py, after the §262 build. NB = h_add + h_del = 12; the NK block is S[:, NB] (13 blocks under --nk 1).
